en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside cityscape with a broad river in the foreground, embankments on both sides, carriages or small boats along the water, and a bridge crossing the river. On the right stands an ornate multi‑story historic building, while the left bank is lined with trees and smaller houses. In the background, a hill rises steeply, crowned with fortification structures and a prominent tower. Handwritten cursive text overlays the image. Printed caption text appears at the top.
